newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel up 8.33 pct on technical rally.
newsitem.headline: Piltel up 8.33 pct on technical rally.

text.p: Cellular phone company Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) on Monday hit an intra-day high of 16.25 pesos, up by 1.25 peso, or 8.33 percent on a technical rebound, brokers said.

"For the past two weeks, the issue has been sold off so much on account of its doubtful accounts problem, that it is natural for the stock to rally and then form a new base," said Allan Araullo of Regina Capital Development Corp.
"The issue has hit a bottom and bargain-hunting ensued. But even if it's a tecnical buy, fundamentally it's still an avoid," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.

"There was heavy selling on Piltel early this month especially after it announced its 1996 earnings where an earlier provision for doubtful accounts was not enough to cover the entire amount," Liboro added.
Since last year, Piltel share price has been battered by its disclosure of troubles brought about by cloning and bad subscriber debt.
The cellular phone firm was among the top 10 most heavily traded issues in Monday's trade with value turnover at 82.84 million pesos.
